summary: Public projects created on 23 April 2026: 18 repos and 1 dataset.
intro: Claude Code plugins for data analysis, cleaning, visualisation, corpus work and local web capture sit alongside an Israel-specific skills set. Further repositories cover LLM council variants for decisions, house hunting and policy ideation, plus indexes of AI data and presentation tooling. A whiteboard dataset supports vision-language OCR evaluation.
